name: k25-kirana-offer
prompt:
A small kirana shop in Nagpur at mid-morning, seen from behind the owner's right shoulder and a little above, so that the camera looks past his shoulder at the phone he is reading: the owner (a man in his forties, a cream half-sleeve shirt, a red tilak on his forehead, short neat hair, a moustache) stands behind his counter holding his one phone in both hands in front of his chest, its screen facing him, and reads it with a slight smile, his face in three-quarter profile; from this angle the phone's screen is seen almost square-on over his shoulder, upright and readable, showing exactly the offer screen in the reference image (a white page with Hindi text, a large price, a green button at the bottom). There is exactly one phone in the picture, in his hands, and no floating or inset screen anywhere; he has exactly two arms and two hands, both on the phone. Beyond him, the counter, strips of hanging Munchly snack packets, shelves of jars and a few Munchly cartons, each with its printed product label, and a customer across the counter facing him. Medium shot, 35 mm, daylight from the street, the phone's screen and the side of his face sharp.

Photorealistic cinematic film still, live action, 35 mm, eye level, shallow depth of field, natural light, real skin and fabric. The cartons are kraft-brown shipping cartons, each carrying one large printed product label exactly like the label in the reference photo: a white sticker with a maroon band reading MUNCHLY MASALA CHIPS (or MUNCHLY MANGO DRINK), the ingredients line, a boxed net quantity and MRP, a boxed BATCH NO, MFG and BEST BEFORE dates, the maker's address, the FSSAI mark, a barcode and a QR code, with a blue storage line at the foot; the label is crisp, straight and legible; no carton carries plain lettering, every carton carries this label. The snack packets are Munchly's own orange chips packets exactly like the reference pack: an orange-to-red gradient with the white MUNCHLY wordmark on a green swoosh and 'Masala Chips' beneath; the Mango Drink packs are small yellow-orange tetra packs with a mango and the word Munchly. No other text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere. No number plate. No children.
